info.title: ragnet - command-line access to a configured Rag.NET pipeline.
info.description: Command-line tool for Rag.NET (`ragnet`): ingest a file or directory into, and retrieve chunks from, a configured pipeline — appsettings.json or environment variables, the same seam Rag.NET.Mcp.Tool uses.

commands.name: ingest
commands.description: Ingest a file or a directory of files.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Retrieve chunks relevant to a question.
